column1: # Partition table for 8MB flash modules (typical S3 dev board). App
# partition offsets are left blank so the ESP-IDF partition table generator
# components/partition_table/ in the ESP-IDF tree) -- the exact resulting
# offsets are printed by `idf.py build` / `idf.py partition-table`.
# factory is sized 1.5MB (not the more typical 1MB) because enabling all of
# mbedtls/TLS + esp_http_client + cJSON alone is already close to 1MB;
# NimBLE adds another ~250-300KB on top) -- confirmed by building against
# the real espressif/idf:release-v5.5 image. Shrink back to 0x100000 if you
# `idf.py build` only WARNS on a factory/app size overflow
# the build -- esptool has no concept of partition boundaries and will
# happily flash straight into the next partition. Never run `idf.py flash`
# after a size-overflow warning; fix the sizes first or the next
